name: Pull-down button and context menu (iOS)
summary: A button that opens a menu of actions. The same menu appears from a long press as a context menu. Destructive items are red and last.

anatomy.purpose: Button with a chevron or ellipsis.
Rounded list of actions with optional icons.

whenToUse: Several related actions without cluttering the screen.
whenNotToUse: One main action: show a button.
Choosing a value: use a pop-up button or picker.

keyboard: Enter, Space or Down Arrow opens it.
accessibility.focus: Focus moves into the menu and returns to the button.
notes: Every item has a text label.
Mark destructive items with words and color.
Menu items are at least 44pt tall.
